meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会借助浏览器工具打开网页、读取内容、点击链接、填写表单、截图、提取数据，也能执行网页上的 JavaScript。当任务涉及上网时，它会主动使用浏览器，不必等你明确说“打开浏览器”。
howto.when: 当任务需要浏览网页、查资料、填表、截图或测试页面时，或判断浏览器有助于完成任务时，Claude 就会启动浏览器操作。

say.text: 帮我查一下什么是量子计算。
say.note: Claude 会用浏览器搜索并总结结果。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截取整页截图。
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图。

say.text: 提取这个页面上所有商品的名称和价格。
say.note: Claude 会解析页面并列出数据。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses a browser to open pages, read content, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and run JavaScript. It proactively browses whenever a task involves the web, even if not explicitly asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task needs browsing, research, form filling, screenshots, or page testing, or whenever Claude judges a browser would be helpful.

say_en.text: Look up what quantum computing is.
say_en.note: Claude will search and summarize results.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save the screenshot.

say_en.text: Extract the names and prices of all products on this page.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the page and list the data.
